name: rumyantsevo_image_prompt_template
content:
Task: Extract the exact digits displayed on the mechanical water meters in the image.
Context:
{context_block}
Instructions:
1. Multiple Meters: There are two water meters visible in the image. Order the array strictly from LEFT to RIGHT: 1st item = leftmost meter, 2nd item = rightmost meter (regardless of vertical height).
2. Meter Structure: Each meter displays a row of 8 digits separated into two zones:
- The first 5 digits on the left (integer cubic meters, white text on black background).
- The last 3 digits on the right (fractional cubic meters, red/white text inside the red border/background).
3. Digit-by-Digit Inspection: Before filling black_digits and red_digits, inspect positions 1..5 (integer) and 6..8 (fractional) one by one from left to right in digit_analysis so no fractional digit bleeds into black_digits.
4. Misaligned Digits: If a digit is misaligned (rolling up or down), report the specific digit that occupies the majority of the viewing window.
5. Visual Artifacts: Ignore bright reflections, specular glare on the clear plastic cover, vertical shadows, or serial numbers/text printed outside the main digit wheel windows.
Output Format:
Return ONLY a JSON array strictly in the following format:

JSON
[
  {
    "digit_analysis": "pos 1..5 integer, pos 6..8 fractional",
    "black_digits": "XXXXX",
    "red_digits": "YYY",
    "full_reading": "XXXXXYYY"
  },
  {
    "digit_analysis": "pos 1..5 integer, pos 6..8 fractional",
    "black_digits": "XXXXX",
    "red_digits": "YYY",
    "full_reading": "XXXXXYYY"
  }
]
